title: Maggie
creator: CrossFit
description: Five rounds of 20 handstand push-ups, 40 pull-ups and 60 alternating pistols for time. A huge volume of gymnastics — 600 reps in total — making it one of the hardest bodyweight Girls. Scale by halving the reps or substituting pike push-ups and box pistols.
